reasoning_traces.think:
The core innovation lies in modeling label hierarchies as directed graphs and integrating them into deep learning frameworks. The HiAGM model introduces two variants: HiAGM-LA uses attention to fuse label-aware text features, while HiAGM-TP propagates text features through the hierarchy. These primitives enable global modeling of label dependencies, addressing limitations of prior local methods. The hierarchy-aware structure encoder leverages TreeLSTM or hierarchy-GCN to capture top-down and bottom-up label correlations. In GSI, this translates to Bayesian belief updates over hierarchical label spaces, where each label's posterior depends on its ancestors and descendants. In GSE, it enables dynamic state transitions between text and label representations, allowing for real-time reasoning about multi-path classifications. The failure mode arises when the graph structure does not reflect true semantic relationships or when attention weights become uninformative.
